name: WACO Taperwing (ASO / ATO / BSO / CSO / CTO / DSO)
summary: High-performance development of the Waco 10 with tapered wings and powerful radial engines; the barnstorming and air-racing Taperwing is a prized antique.

wings: Tapered biplane wings: chord narrows toward the tips on both upper and lower wings
Ailerons on both upper and lower wings
engines: Powerful radial engine (Wright Whirlwind, Continental or Warner), often with a ring cowl
fuselage: Tandem open cockpits with a front cockpit for two passengers ahead of the pilot
tail: Rounded fin and rudder with an adjustable tailplane

tellTales: Biplane whose upper and lower wings narrow toward the tips
Radial-engined open-cockpit biplane with a wide front cockpit
Strut-linked ailerons on both upper and lower wings

confusedWith.howToTell: The Waco 10 has straight, untapered wings; the Taperwing wings narrow toward the tips.
The F-series has straight, rounded wings and a more streamlined fuselage; the Taperwing wings visibly taper.
The Stearman has straight, constant-chord wings and a bare radial; the Taperwing wings taper.
